content: 'Apɨrami kemɨranayexeiyarie
Merikɨtsɨ Yawé 'Apɨrami mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
Hikɨ 'Apɨrami kanayeyani, Yawé kemɨrehɨawekai, meta Ruti hamatɨana kaneyani. Kepauka mayetɨa 'Apɨrami Karani kiekariyaritsie haika tewiyari heimana tamamata heimana 'auxɨwime wiyari pexeiyakai.
Kepauka metɨa 'Apɨrami Kanani paitɨ, yu'ɨya pewitɨ Tsarahi, meta yumatsu Ruti, yaxeikɨa yunaime te'i'uximayatsiriwamete Karani mɨwarutinanekai, meta tita memɨtehexeiyakai. Kepauka Kanani memuye'axɨa,
'Apɨrami mana 'uyeyaka Tsikeni mɨrakutewatsiepai kaninuani, xiu manuwe mɨrayutimawatɨre Mure mɨrakutewatsie. 'Ana mana kananeutsixi mepɨtitekai mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie.
Mana Yawé 'Apɨrami mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe: «Ne 'ikɨ kwie 'anuiwarima nekaniwayetuiriemɨkɨ». Hikɨ mana 'Apɨrami tenutsari mawari wewiwame kaniutawewieni Yawé hetsiemieme, mana mitahɨawixɨkɨ.

Mana mɨyetɨa kaneyani muhɨriyatsie Weteri 'aurie, mana nuaka kaniuyutaxamarutɨani, Weteri tau makayuyuipike katini'anekaitɨni 'Ahi kiekariyarita tau manatineika. Manatatsiere tenutsari timawame kaniutawewieni, Yawé mahɨawenikɨ.
Manata mɨyetɨa 'Apɨrami 'axɨkai 'umietɨ 'uyerɨximetɨ Nekexi kwieyaritsie paitɨ kaniye'ani.
'Apɨrami kemɨretɨa 'Ekipitu
Hikɨ 'ana haakaxa kanayani waɨkawa 'Apɨrami manukateitsie, 'ayumieme kaneyani 'Ekipitu paitɨ.
Hikɨ kepauka 'Ekipitu meutahanikekai, mɨpaɨ yu'ɨya Tsarahi katiniutahɨawe: «Ne nepɨtimate 'ekɨ 'uka witsipepɨti'ɨimari.
Nepɨtimate kepauka memɨmatsihexeiya 'ekipitutari mɨpaɨ mepetiyuani: “Ti'a'ɨya 'ikɨ”, 'anari mekanenemiekuni, 'ekɨta mekamanehayewakuni.
Peru neuxei mɨpaɨ kenetayɨki ximɨxi kename ne'iwa pehɨkɨ, ne 'atsinemɨkaheku'itɨariwanikɨ 'ekɨ mɨpaɨ pehetayɨyu, nemɨkahekumemieriwanikɨ».
Kepauka meta'a 'Apɨrami 'Ekipitu kwieyaritsie, 'ekipitutari Tsarahi witsimekateniuxeiya.
Yaxeikɨata mekanixeiya, te'uximayatamete Parahuni hetsɨa miemete, hikɨ mekanekɨne meteheitaxatɨanike 'uka witsikemɨti'ɨimarikaikɨ. Hikɨ 'ayumieme kanewitɨkieni paratsiyu paitɨ.
Tsarahi hetsiemieme 'Apɨrami 'aixɨa mekateniuxeiya. Katiniyetuiriyarieni muxatsi, wakaitsixi, puxuri, kameyutsixi meta te'uximayatamete 'ukitsi 'ukari.
Perutsɨ Tsarahi hetsiemiemekɨ 'Apɨrami 'ɨyaya, Yawé Parahuni kaniu'uximatɨani meta yunaime tɨɨriyamama waɨkawa kwiniyakɨ.
'Ayumieme Parahuni pɨtiutanɨ'a, mɨwitɨkiemiekɨ 'Apɨrami, mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: «¿Titayari mɨya penetiuyuri? ¿Titayari mɨpaɨ pekanetiutahɨawixɨ kename 'ikɨ 'a'ɨyatɨkai?
¿Titayari kename 'a'iwa petiutayɨ? Ketakuta matsi ne'itiwitɨnike. Hikɨri 'a'ɨya kenawitɨtɨ keneumieni».
Parahuni yuteɨterima kaniwaruta'aitɨani 'Apɨrami memayeweiyakɨ meta 'ɨyaya metatsiere tita mɨrexeiyakai.
